claude_old: ! Claude Code 2.1.282 can't show the crew pane (needs 2.1.287) — claude update
cli_fallback: Everything the page does is a command too: crew add project, crew ls projects|workspaces|worktrees, crew help.
configure_in_browser: configure in the browser: run crew
dev_server_added: Added dev server 'worker' to store-api (no port — it does not listen)
dev_server_renamed: Renamed dev server 'server' → 'api' in store-api (:3000); 1 scoped binding(s) follow it
fix_hint:
crew fix store-front/wrk1     Claude in the worktree with this failure
    crew verify store-front/wrk1  finish what is missing and check again
health_warning: ! store-front/wrk1: 2 issues — crew fix store-front/wrk1 / crew verify store-front/wrk1
import_collision: project 'store-api' is already in the pool — choose another name
invalid_project_name: 'Store API' is not a valid project name — use a-z, 0-9 and -
invalid_worktree_name: worktree name 'wrk--1' is invalid — '--' is reserved as the workspace/worktree separator
key_rejected: Soniox rejected that key — check it and try again.
no_dev_server: project 'store-api' has no dev server 'web' (has: api, worker)
plugin_missing: ! crew's Claude Code plugin isn't installed, so the session gets no crew pane — claude plugin install crew@crew
plugin_old: ! crew's Claude Code plugin is 6.0.0; the crew pane needs 6.6.0 — claude plugin update crew@crew
pool_removal_adopted: your checkout at ~/code/signals is left alone
pool_removal_refused: project 'store-api' is still in workspace store-front — crew rm workspace store-front store-api first
pool_removal_trashed: clone at ~/.crew/projects/store-api moved to the trash
project_updated:
Setup for store-api: pnpm install
Env command for store-api: make env
remote_machine: This machine is a remote — another machine's crew drives it (crew server remote status). Open crew there.
rename_warning: store-front's STORE_API_URL point at store-api — left alone until re-bound
restart_before_66: store-front/wrk1's servers were started before crew 6.6 — restart them all once: crew dev restart store-front/wrk1
restart_not_in_set: store-api/docs is not in the running set (added since the last start?) — restart them all: crew dev restart store-front/wrk1
restart_not_running: store-front/wrk1 is not running — crew dev start store-front/wrk1
server_ambiguous: "web" is a server in 2 projects — name one: store-api/web, store-front/web
setup_running: setup is running on store-front/wrk1 — crew setup status store-front/wrk1
started:
Created store-front/wrk1 — 2 projects installing in the background.
  crew setup status store-front/wrk1 [--wait]   what each runner has done; --wait stays until every one is done
  crew setup logs store-front/wrk1 <project>    what an install is printing
  http://localhost:7300/   follow it in crew
still_bound: Removed binding SIGNALS_URL from store-api (still bound for all servers)
update_available: crew v4.1.0 — v4.2.0 is available (crew update)
update_current: crew v4.2.0 — up to date (latest v4.2.0)
update_dev: crew (dev build abc123) — crew update installs the latest release (v4.2.0)
update_offline: crew v4.1.0 — could not ask for the latest release: could not reach github.com
voice_alias_note: note: crew voice is crew server now (crew voice keeps working); bare crew starts it and opens the page
